theorems.name: Candidates.RestrictedLedger.restricted_ledger_criterion
theorems.role: 强前提版（保留候选；复核方指出的 hreal 未删除）
premises: hΩ : ∀ x ∈ Ω, ∀ j, x j ≠ 0
hgen : ∀ x ∈ Ω, ∃ lam, vprofile x - vprofile x₀ = ∑ i, lam i • b i
hreal : ∀ i, ∃ x ∈ Ω, vprofile x - vprofile x₀ = b i
theorems.exact_type: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n r : ℕ} (Ω : Set (Tuple p n)), (∀ x ∈ Ω, ∀ j, x j ≠ 0) → ∀ (w : Fin n → ℤ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (a : Fin n → ℚ_[p]), (∀ j, a j ≠ 0) → ∀ x₀ ∈ Ω, ∀ (b : Fin r → Fin n → ℤ), (∀ x ∈ Ω, ∃ lam, vprofile p x - vprofile p x₀ = ∑ i, lam i • b i) → (∀ i, ∃ x ∈ Ω, vprofile p x - vprofile p x₀ = b i) → ((∀ x ∈ Ω, weightedLedger p w (relabel p σ (slotwise p a x)) = weightedLedger p w x) ↔ dot (fun j => w (σ j) - w j) (vprofile p x₀) + ∑ j, w (σ j) * (a j).valuation = 0 ∧ ∀ i, dot (fun j => w (σ j) - w j) (b i) = 0)

theorems.name: Candidates.RestrictedLedger.restricted_ledger_span_criterion
theorems.role: 一般 span 证书版（本轮新增主结果）
premises: hΩ : ∀ x ∈ Ω, ∀ j, x j ≠ 0
hgen : ∀ x ∈ Ω, ∃ lam, vprofile x - vprofile x₀ = ∑ i, lam i • b i
hspan : ∀ i, MemDiffSpanOn p Ω x₀ (b i)
theorems.exact_type: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n r : ℕ} (Ω : Set (Tuple p n)), (∀ x ∈ Ω, ∀ j, x j ≠ 0) → ∀ (w : Fin n → ℤ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (a : Fin n → ℚ_[p]), (∀ j, a j ≠ 0) → ∀ x₀ ∈ Ω, ∀ (b : Fin r → Fin n → ℤ), (∀ x ∈ Ω, ∃ lam, vprofile p x - vprofile p x₀ = ∑ i, lam i • b i) → (∀ i, MemDiffSpanOn p Ω x₀ (b i)) → ((∀ x ∈ Ω, weightedLedger p w (relabel p σ (slotwise p a x)) = weightedLedger p w x) ↔ dot (fun j => w (σ j) - w j) (vprofile p x₀) + ∑ j, w (σ j) * (a j).valuation = 0 ∧ ∀ i, dot (fun j => w (σ j) - w j) (b i) = 0)

defs.MemDiffSpanOn: fun (p) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {n} (Ω : Set (Tuple p n)) (x₀ : Tuple p n) (v : Fin n → ℤ) => ∃ (m : Nat) (x : Fin m → Tuple p n) (lam : Fin m → ℤ), (∀ k, x k ∈ Ω) ∧ v = ∑ k, lam k • (vprofile p (x k) - vprofile p x₀)
defs.MemDiffSpan: fun {n} (S : Set (Fin n → ℤ)) (e₀ v : Fin n → ℤ) => ∃ (m : Nat) (e : Fin m → Fin n → ℤ) (lam : Fin m → ℤ), (∀ k, e k ∈ S) ∧ v = ∑ k, lam k • (e k - e₀)
